title: Container Bookings: Goodwill Waiver Limits by Tier
content:
The goodwill a Container Bookings desk may extend on a fee is bounded by three tier figures: the largest single fee entry it may cancel, how many goodwill waivers one customer may receive in a trailing year, and how long after a fee is booked the customer may still ask.

| Booking product | Largest fee entry the desk may waive (USD) | Goodwill waivers per customer in the trailing 365 days | Days after the fee was booked within which a request may be made |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 0.00 | 0 | 30 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 150.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 250.00 | 2 | 45 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 400.00 | 3 | 45 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 300.00 | 2 | 45 |
| AHL Premium Express | 500.00 | 4 | 60 |

## Remarks

- For AHL Spot Saver both the desk's waiver authority and the yearly quota stand at zero, so no fee on a booking of that product can be waived as goodwill.
- The request period is counted in calendar days from the date on which the fee was entered.
- The figures are applied from the product of the booking that carries the fee in question.

**Hypothetical reading.** A fee entry of 180.00 on an AHL Spot Flex booking exceeds that product's 150.00 authority, whereas the same entry on an AHL Contract Booking booking lies within its 250.00. The amounts are invented.
